description: Vendor evaluation criteria must include a 3-year total-cost-of-ownership model and an explicit NSA-to-SA migration path before any procurement decision is ratified at the Architecture Review Board. Cross-functional review from Network Operations and Finance is mandatory for all decisions exceeding ₹2 crore CapEx.

Capacity models for new platform deployments must include a sensitivity analysis for 3x traffic growth scenarios. The IoT platform capacity model used at project approval underestimated traffic growth by 340%, directly causing the P2 incident and a 3-month project delay. All future platform projects must obtain a NOC capacity sign-off before go-live approval is granted.
Architectural decisions with cross-circle impact must be reviewed by at least two independent domain architects.
Post-go-live hyper-care periods of minimum 30 days must be budgeted into all projects with customer-facing impact.
All integration testing must include a 72-hour production-soak before go-live is approved.
